jobs.title: Director, Private Equity IT M&A –Due Diligence and Value Creation
jobs.description:
The KPMG Advisory practice is at the forefront of transformation, offering excellent opportunities for individuals to advance their careers and expertise with KPMG. Looking ahead, we anticipate continued evolution and success within the practice, fostering both personal and professional development, thereby creating new pathways for growth. In this ever-changing market environment, our professionals must be adaptable and thrive in a collaborative, team-driven culture. At KPMG, our people are our number one priority. With a wealth of learning and career development opportunities, a world-class training facility, and leading market tools, we help our people continue to grow both professionally and personally. If you're looking for a firm with a strong team connection where you can be your whole self, have an impact, advance your skills, deepen your experiences, and have the flexibility and access to constantly find new areas of inspiration and expand your capabilities, then consider a career in Advisory.

KPMG is currently seeking a Director, Private Equity IT M&A –Due Diligence and Value Creation to join our KPMG Strategy practice.

Responsibilities:

Manage a high-volume pipeline of rapid IT due diligenceprojects for Private Equity clients, assessing platform and add-onacquisitions; utilize AI-powered tools to accelerate analysis, identify keytechnology risks, value creation levers, carve-out complexities, and requiredinvestments, delivering concise, actionable reports for investment committees
Develop and execute post-close technologyvalue creation and optimization roadmaps for portfolio companies; leadinitiatives focused on platform modernization, cost take-out, operating modelredesign, and the implementation of data analytics and automation to acceleratethe investment thesis and drive EBITDA improvement
Direct IT integration and carve-out initiativesfrom planning through execution; establish and manage governance frameworks forvalue creation programs, ensuring rigorous oversight of execution, trackingsynergy realization, cost savings, and ROI on technology investments, andreporting progress to PE stakeholders and portfolio leadership
Develop and execute go-to-market strategiesfocused on technology-driven value creation for the PE sector; act as a keythought leader on how to leverage technology, including AI/ML, to drivescalability and strategic advantage across portfolio companies
Lead strategic discussions andpresentations with key stakeholders, including PE deal teams, operatingpartners, and portfolio company executives, acting as a trusted advisor ontechnology strategy from diligence through exit
Lead efforts to mentor and develop junior staff, fosteringdeep expertise in the fast-paced PE deal lifecycle, technology value creationmethodologies, and delivery excellence
Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment

Qualifications:

Minimum eight years of recent experience in technology, with a strongpreference for candidates who have held in-house technology leadership roles(such as CIO, CTO, VP Engineering) within a PE-backed company or a high-growthtech firm; consulting experience focused on the PE sector is also valuable
Master's of Business Administration degree from an accredited college or university is preferred; Minimum of a Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, or a related fieldis required
Demonstrated success in leading high-impacttechnology projects in areas such as IT due diligence, technology valuecreation, post-merger integration, or IT architecture modernization. Provenability to leverage AI-powered tools and platforms to accelerate due diligence,identify opportunities, and enhance project delivery
Proven track record operating in the fast-paced, high-stakesenvironment of Private Equity, leading technology engagements from pre-dealdiligence through post-close value creation. Experience with portfoliocompanies in sectors such as Technology, Software, and other tech-enabledindustries is highly preferred
Comprehensive understanding of modern enterprise ITecosystems, including cloud platforms, business applications, infrastructure,and cybersecurity; familiarity with the security, data privacy, andconsiderations of implementing AI/ML solutions
Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies anddriving business growth, specifically by building and nurturing relationshipswith PE operating partners and deal teams
Willingnessand ability to travel as needed to serve client needs.
Mustbe authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visasponsorship now or in the future. KPMG LLP will not sponsor applicants for U.S.work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B,L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-basedvisa)

jobs.title: Senior Director, Marketing Technology
jobs.description:
Bounteous is a global AI Services firm where agentic engineering and human experience converge to deliver transformative business outcomes for the enterprise. We help organizations design, build, and scale AI-driven products, platforms, and processes. With more than 5,000 team members worldwide, Bounteous delivers AI that sticks, powering adoption and outcomes that move organizations from experimentation to true transformation. Bounteous is backed by New Mountain Capital, a New York-based growth-oriented investment firm that emphasizes business building.

We are seeking an experienced Competency Leader with deep technical expertise in Adobe platforms to join our growing Modern Business Platforms practice. Positioned to ensure a seamless transition from pre-sales through delivery, this role serves as a trusted advisor to clients and Adobe partners, with a primary focus on optimizing customer experiences and marketing strategies through the Adobe Experience Platform (particularly Real-Time CDP)and the newer Adobe CX Enterprise solution. A strong understanding of broader data, marketing, and AI technologies to design scalable architectures and strategies for successful platform implementations and launches is critical to success.

The Competency Leader partners with client service and business development teams to identify and expand account opportunities, creating solutions that maximize customer value through Adobe platforms. This role is also central to shaping how clients think about and adopt AI-powered capabilities - from Adobe's native AI tooling to broader agentic and generative AI patterns that integrate with and extend the platform's value. This high-visibility role supports partnerships with Adobe and other platforms to foster innovation, drive product adoption, achieve company certifications, and influence product roadmaps.

Information Security Responsibilities

Promote and enforce awareness of key information security practices, including acceptable use of information assets, malware protection, and password security protocols
Identify, assess, and report security risks, focusing on how these risks impact the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets
Understand and evaluate how data is stored, processed, or transmitted, ensuring compliance with data privacy and protection standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)
Ensure data protection measures are integrated throughout the information lifecycle to safeguard sensitive information

Role & Responsibilities

Serve as a platform expert in Adobe Experience Platform Real-Time CDP and other products (CJA, Target, AJO,Adobe CX Enterprise).
Maintain subject matter expertise as platforms evolve - with particular emphasis on Adobe's expanding AI capabilities - including leading development of playbooks and documentation for scaling solutions
Build out accelerators and features aimed at creating efficiencies leading to strong customer value realization and/or optimizations, including AI-assisted workflows and prompt-driven tooling that accelerate pre-sales and delivery cycles.
Collaborate with platform partners on product roadmap advisory, feature exploration and development, and integration solutions and approaches
Drive achievement and maintenance of Adobe platform certifications across the competency, in support of company partnership goals
Advise clients on AI enablement strategies within the Adobe ecosystem
Guide clients in evaluating and adopting Adobe's AI-native capabilities, including AI-assisted segmentation, predictive scoring, and generative content workflows (GenStudio, Firefly Services), as well as Adobe's Brand Intelligence engine.
Identify opportunities to layer agentic AI patterns, including MCP-based integrations and orchestrated AI workflows, onto existing Adobe platform investments.
Serve as a credible voice on the distinction between platform-native AI capabilities and strategic AI augmentation, helping clients sequence adoption appropriately
Partner with client service and business development to support pitches and follow-on client work
Strategize, architect, and create approaches for scalable, tailored CDP implementations
Present and articulate subject matter expertise through compelling client presentations
Own or co-own SOW creation and commercial framing for AEP/RTCDP and CJA engagements; collaborate on multi-solution and multi-platform solutioning and scoping
Lead customer-facing workshops, demos, and hands-on labs, including AI capability showcases and proof-of-concept engagements.
Ensure continuity from solution through delivery
Own handoff protocols between pre-sales and delivery teams, maintaining solution integrity and client confidence through project kickoff
Remain engaged as a strategic resource during early delivery phases to resolve ambiguity, validate architectural decisions, and support scope management
Provide deep domain expertise in client business, technology stack, and data infrastructure — spanning CDP, content supply chain (AEM), and adjacent platforms — complemented by a wide-ranging knowledge base in digital marketing and applied AI

Preferred Qualifications

10+ years of experience creating customer data and marketing technology solutions
3+ years of experience at a digital-first, global delivery agency/consultancy
Strong consultative and client-facing skills
Hands-on experience with Adobe Experience Platform RTCDP, including creating schemas, ingesting data from a variety of sources, configuring identity resolution, and connecting destinations for activation
Familiarity with AEP's AI/ML capabilities, including Customer AI (propensity and churn models), Attribution AI, and the AEP AI Assistant
Familiarity with Adobe CX Enterprise and Agent Orchestrator, including Agent Composer, Brand and Concierge.
Hands-on experience with Adobe Tags (formerly “Launch”) and AEP WebSDK implementation
Working knowledge of the entire Adobe Experience Platform range of products (RTCDP, CJA, AJO, Mix Modeler) and related platforms (such as Target; familiarity with GenStudio, Firefly Services, AEM, and Workfront a plus).
Strong understanding of customer data platforms and the modern data infrastructure, such as Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, Google BigQuery, etc.
Understanding of generative AI and agentic AI concepts, including prompt engineering, RAG architectures, MCP integrations, and AI orchestration patterns - sufficient to advise clients and position solutions credibly.
Adobe Experience Platform certification (RTCDP or equivalent) strongly preferred; commitment to maintaining certifications as platforms evolve expected
Self-driven; the ability to work independently, define a way forward, and solve problems with limited direction; proven capacity to drive results in an evolving and complex organization
Strong communicator with all levels of leadership, management, and staff to achieve desired outcomes and build strong alliances and relationships
Outstanding executive presence, presentation, and negotiation skills; the ability to inspire, engage, partner with, and influence senior leadership
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Digitally savvy and well-informed on innovations, trends, and technologies - especially the intersection of AI and marketing technology
Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Analytics, or related field, or equivalent work experience preferred

$180,000 - $240,000 a year

The range listed reflects the base salary for this role. Individual pay is determined by many factors, including experience, relevant education or training, and organizational needs. The mid-range to maximum of the salary range is generally reserved for individuals who are highly experienced in the role. This position is also eligible to participate in Bounteous' Business Development Commission plan, with details provided during the interview process.

Bounteous does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law. jobs.title: Chief Information Officer
jobs.description:
Job Title:
Chief information officer

Location:
US

Company:
TALENTER

Work Place Type:
Remote

Job Type:
Full Time

The Chief Information Officer is a senior leadership position responsible for developing and executing the organization’s overall marketing strategy to strengthen the brand, expand market presence, attract customers, and drive sustainable business growth. The COO works closely with the CEO and senior management to ensure marketing initiatives support the company’s vision, objectives, and long-term strategy.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and implement comprehensive short-term and long-term marketing strategies aligned with business objectives.
Lead brand positioning, brand development, corporate identity, communications, and reputation management.
Plan and oversee integrated marketing campaigns across digital and traditional channels.
Manage digital marketing activities, including social media, SEO, SEM, content marketing, email marketing, and online advertising.
Develop customer acquisition, engagement, retention, and loyalty strategies.
Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and potential risks.
Oversee product launches, promotional campaigns, events, exhibitions, partnerships, and public relations activities.
Collaborate with Sales and Business Development teams to generate qualified leads and support revenue growth.
Manage the marketing budget and ensure effective resource allocation and measurable return on investment.
Establish and monitor KPIs, including lead generation, conversion rates, customer acquisition cost, brand awareness, engagement, and marketing ROI.
Recruit, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing marketing team.
Manage relationships with agencies, media partners, consultants, and external service providers.
Collaborate with Product, Finance, Operations, Sales, and other departments to achieve organizational goals.
Monitor industry developments, emerging technologies, customer behavior, and changing market trends.

Positioned to ensure a seamless transition from pre-sales through delivery, this role serves as a trusted advisor to clients and Adobe partners, with a primary focus on optimizing customer experiences and marketing strategies through the Adobe Experience Platform (particularly Real-Time CDP)and the newer Adobe CX Enterprise solution. A strong understanding of broader data, marketing, and AI technologies to design scalable architectures and strategies for successful platform implementations and launches is critical to success.

The Competency Leader partners with client service and business development teams to identify and expand account opportunities, creating solutions that maximize customer value through Adobe platforms. This role is also central to shaping how clients think about and adopt AI-powered capabilities - from Adobe's native AI tooling to broader agentic and generative AI patterns that integrate with and extend the platform's value. This high-visibility role supports partnerships with Adobe and other platforms to foster innovation, drive product adoption, achieve company certifications, and influence product roadmaps.

Information Security Responsibilities

Promote and enforce awareness of key information security practices, including acceptable use of information assets, malware protection, and password security protocols
Identify, assess, and report security risks, focusing on how these risks impact the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets
Understand and evaluate how data is stored, processed, or transmitted, ensuring compliance with data privacy and protection standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)
Ensure data protection measures are integrated throughout the information lifecycle to safeguard sensitive information

Role & Responsibilities

Serve as a platform expert in Adobe Experience Platform Real-Time CDP and other products (CJA, Target, AJO,Adobe CX Enterprise).
Maintain subject matter expertise as platforms evolve - with particular emphasis on Adobe's expanding AI capabilities - including leading development of playbooks and documentation for scaling solutions
Build out accelerators and features aimed at creating efficiencies leading to strong customer value realization and/or optimizations, including AI-assisted workflows and prompt-driven tooling that accelerate pre-sales and delivery cycles.
Collaborate with platform partners on product roadmap advisory, feature exploration and development, and integration solutions and approaches
Drive achievement and maintenance of Adobe platform certifications across the competency, in support of company partnership goals
Advise clients on AI enablement strategies within the Adobe ecosystem
Guide clients in evaluating and adopting Adobe's AI-native capabilities, including AI-assisted segmentation, predictive scoring, and generative content workflows (GenStudio, Firefly Services), as well as Adobe's Brand Intelligence engine.
Identify opportunities to layer agentic AI patterns, including MCP-based integrations and orchestrated AI workflows, onto existing Adobe platform investments.
Serve as a credible voice on the distinction between platform-native AI capabilities and strategic AI augmentation, helping clients sequence adoption appropriately
Partner with client service and business development to support pitches and follow-on client work
Strategize, architect, and create approaches for scalable, tailored CDP implementations
Present and articulate subject matter expertise through compelling client presentations
Own or co-own SOW creation and commercial framing for AEP/RTCDP and CJA engagements; collaborate on multi-solution and multi-platform solutioning and scoping
Lead customer-facing workshops, demos, and hands-on labs, including AI capability showcases and proof-of-concept engagements.
Ensure continuity from solution through delivery
Own handoff protocols between pre-sales and delivery teams, maintaining solution integrity and client confidence through project kickoff
Remain engaged as a strategic resource during early delivery phases to resolve ambiguity, validate architectural decisions, and support scope management
Provide deep domain expertise in client business, technology stack, and data infrastructure — spanning CDP, content supply chain (AEM), and adjacent platforms — complemented by a wide-ranging knowledge base in digital marketing and applied AI

Preferred Qualifications

10+ years of experience creating customer data and marketing technology solutions
3+ years of experience at a digital-first, global delivery agency/consultancy
Strong consultative and client-facing skills
Hands-on experience with Adobe Experience Platform RTCDP, including creating schemas, ingesting data from a variety of sources, configuring identity resolution, and connecting destinations for activation
Familiarity with AEP's AI/ML capabilities, including Customer AI (propensity and churn models), Attribution AI, and the AEP AI Assistant
Familiarity with Adobe CX Enterprise and Agent Orchestrator, including Agent Composer, Brand and Concierge.
Hands-on experience with Adobe Tags (formerly “Launch”) and AEP WebSDK implementation
Working knowledge of the entire Adobe Experience Platform range of products (RTCDP, CJA, AJO, Mix Modeler) and related platforms (such as Target; familiarity with GenStudio, Firefly Services, AEM, and Workfront a plus).
Strong understanding of customer data platforms and the modern data infrastructure, such as Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, Google BigQuery, etc.
Understanding of generative AI and agentic AI concepts, including prompt engineering, RAG architectures, MCP integrations, and AI orchestration patterns - sufficient to advise clients and position solutions credibly.
Adobe Experience Platform certification (RTCDP or equivalent) strongly preferred; commitment to maintaining certifications as platforms evolve expected
Self-driven; the ability to work independently, define a way forward, and solve problems with limited direction; proven capacity to drive results in an evolving and complex organization
Strong communicator with all levels of leadership, management, and staff to achieve desired outcomes and build strong alliances and relationships
Outstanding executive presence, presentation, and negotiation skills; the ability to inspire, engage, partner with, and influence senior leadership
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Digitally savvy and well-informed on innovations, trends, and technologies - especially the intersection of AI and marketing technology
Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Analytics, or related field, or equivalent work experience preferred

$180,000 - $240,000 a year

The range listed reflects the base salary for this role. Individual pay is determined by many factors, including experience, relevant education or training, and organizational needs. The mid-range to maximum of the salary range is generally reserved for individuals who are highly experienced in the role. The Chief Information Officer is a senior leadership position responsible for developing and executing the organization’s overall marketing strategy to strengthen the brand, expand market presence, attract customers, and drive sustainable business growth. The COO works closely with the CEO and senior management to ensure marketing initiatives support the company’s vision, objectives, and long-term strategy.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and implement comprehensive short-term and long-term marketing strategies aligned with business objectives.
Lead brand positioning, brand development, corporate identity, communications, and reputation management.
Plan and oversee integrated marketing campaigns across digital and traditional channels.
Manage digital marketing activities, including social media, SEO, SEM, content marketing, email marketing, and online advertising.
Develop customer acquisition, engagement, retention, and loyalty strategies.
Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and potential risks.
Oversee product launches, promotional campaigns, events, exhibitions, partnerships, and public relations activities.
Collaborate with Sales and Business Development teams to generate qualified leads and support revenue growth.
Manage the marketing budget and ensure effective resource allocation and measurable return on investment.
Establish and monitor KPIs, including lead generation, conversion rates, customer acquisition cost, brand awareness, engagement, and marketing ROI.
Recruit, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing marketing team.
Manage relationships with agencies, media partners, consultants, and external service providers.
Collaborate with Product, Finance, Operations, Sales, and other departments to achieve organizational goals.
Monitor industry developments, emerging technologies, customer behavior, and changing market trends.
